FaqPage.heroBody: Everything you need to know about PAII certifications, exams, and credentials.
FaqPage.cat1q1Q: Do I need a technical background to enroll?
FaqPage.cat1q1A: No. PAII certifications are designed for business professionals, not engineers. CAIP, CAIM, and CAIE require no programming or data science background. CAIDA benefits from familiarity with data tools but doesn't require coding.
FaqPage.cat1q2Q: Which certification should I start with?
FaqPage.cat1q2A: 87% of PAII professionals start with CAIP regardless of seniority. It establishes a common foundation. After CAIP, choose CAIM (management), CAIDA (data), or CAIE (Educator) based on your role.
FaqPage.cat1q3A: Yes. Many professionals complete CAIP followed by CAIM or CAIDA. CAIP alumni receive a 15% discount on subsequent certifications.
FaqPage.cat1q4A: CAIP has no prerequisites. CAIM and CAIDA recommend CAIP but don't require it. CAIE is designed for senior professionals and recommends 3+ years in a leadership role.
FaqPage.cat2q1Q: How does the application process work?
FaqPage.cat2q1A: You submit a brief application (5 minutes), pay the enrollment fee, and PAII reviews your application within 3–5 business days. You receive your LMS access credentials via email upon approval.
FaqPage.cat2q2Q: Why do I need to apply? Can't I just enroll?
FaqPage.cat2q2A: PAII's application process ensures credential integrity and helps us understand your professional context for the best learning experience. Applications are rarely declined — it's not an exclusionary process.
FaqPage.cat2q3Q: What if my application is rejected?
FaqPage.cat2q3A: You'll receive a full refund within 5–7 business days. In most cases, rejections come with guidance on reapplying or on alternative pathways.
FaqPage.cat3q1A: Online, proctored through our secure testing platform. You can take it from home or office. You'll need a webcam, government ID, and a quiet space.
FaqPage.cat3q2A: One retake is included in your enrollment fee. If you fail a second time, additional retake is for $99. Detailed score reports guide your preparation.
FaqPage.cat3q3A: CAIP, CAIM, and CAIDA: 90 minutes, 75 questions. CAIE: 75 minutes, 60 questions. All are multiple-choice.
FaqPage.cat3q4Q: When can I take the exam?
FaqPage.cat3q4A: You can schedule your exam at any time after completing all required modules. No cohort deadlines — take it when you're ready.
FaqPage.cat4q1Q: How long is the certification valid?
FaqPage.cat4q1A: CAIP, CAIM, and CAIDA are valid for 2 years. CAIE is valid for 3 years. Renewal involves a shorter recertification exam or continuing education credits.
FaqPage.cat4q2Q: How do employers verify my credential?
FaqPage.cat4q2A: Each certificate includes a unique ID and QR code. Employers can verify instantly at paii.ca/verify. You can also add your credential directly to LinkedIn.
FaqPage.cat4q3A: Yes. PAII credentials are recognized by employers across 48 countries. Our ISO/IEC 17024:2026-aligned framework aligns with international standards for professional certifications.
FaqPage.cat5q1A: All major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), debit cards, and bank transfers for corporate orders. Payments are processed via Stripe.
FaqPage.cat5q2A: Full refund within 30 days of enrollment if you haven't passed the exam. No refunds after exam attempt. Corporate orders: contact corporate@paii.ca.
FaqPage.cat5q3A: Yes. We partner with third-party financing providers. Contact info@paii.ca for details on installment payment options.
FaqPage.teamRespondsBody: Our team responds within 24 hours on business days.
